findings.title: Unreadable-image branch does not activate the shared state primitive
findings.detail: The placeholder declares data-component="mg-state" and renders mg-state-art, but its root class list omits the required global mg-state class. data-component is not a styling hook in mediaPrimitives.css, so the branch does not receive the canonical state layout or state semantics; data-tone="warn" is likewise not consumed by the primitive. This is an invalid shared-primitive use even though the private resourcePlaceholder class supplies a partial local appearance.

findings.title: Panel accents use unsupported ownership values
findings.detail: The attachment uses data-accent="blue" and the protected snapshot at line 64 uses data-accent="amber", but mediaDesignTokens.css defines accent ownership only for studio, campaign, business, desk, agent, and archive. Because .mg-panel[data-accent] still matches these unsupported values, both panels consume inherited --accent-* variables instead of the declared blue/amber intent, misattributing their visual emphasis and source-authority presentation.
